text: Skip to main content Processing status for tax forms English Español More In Help Interactive Tax Assistant Tools Report fraud Tax scams Identity theft Notices and letters Appeals Frequently asked questions Accessibility Contact your local IRS office Contact an international IRS office Tax topics Other languages Find our current processing status and what to expect for the tax form types listed below. Individual returns Electronically filed Form 1040 returns are generally processed within 21 days. We’re currently processing paper returns received during the months below. Form 1040 series Original: September 2026 Amended: June 2026 This does not include those that require error correction or other special handling. We generally process paper returns where a refund is expected before all other returns. Business returns Electronically filed original returns are generally processed within 21 days. We’re currently processing paper returns received during the months below. Form 1120 series Original: September 2026 Amended: June 2026 Form 941 Original: September 2026 Amended (excluding ERC): June 2026 Form 1041 Original: September 2026 Amended: June 2026 This does not include those that require error correction or other special handling. We generally process paper returns where a refund is expected before all other returns. Forms 2848 and 8821 Form 2848, Power of Attorney and Declaration of Representative Processed 7 business days after receipt Form 8821, Tax Information Authorization Processed 7 business days after receipt If you already submitted Forms 2848 or 8821: Please don’t submit a duplicate form. Get real-time processing for POA and TIA requests with Tax Pro Account . Other forms We’re currently processing forms we received during the months shown below. Form W-7 , Application for IRS Individual Taxpayer Identification Number (ITIN) August 2026 Form 8802 , Application for U.S. Residency Certification July 2026 Form 1045 , Application for Tentative Refund July 2026 Form 1139 , Corporation Application for Tentative Refund July 2026 Form 14039 , Individual Identify Theft Affidavit July 2025 Form 14039-B , Business Identify Theft Affidavit July 2025 Form SS-4 , Application for Employer Identification Number Fax: Processed 10 business days after receipt Paper: Processed within 30 days of receipt Letters and notices We’re currently processing correspondence we received during the months shown below.
